_provenance.method: Hugging Face API (tree + revision endpoints, read-only, no download).
_provenance.revisions: Every artifact is pinned to the commit sha of the repository at verification time, so the resolve URL is immutable even if the branch moves.
_provenance.hashes: The HF API did not expose a sha256 for these artifacts (Xet/LFS storage), so NO hash is recorded. Sizes are exact as reported by the API. Do not add a hash that was not read from the file itself.
_provenance.sizes: bytes = exact size reported by the API for the pinned revision; verified against the URLs below with a HEAD request.
_provenance.catalog_ratings: Every file carries a 1-5 star rating for this toolkit's task and, where it matters, the hardware classes it is intended for. Sizes and revisions were read from the Hugging Face tree API on 2026-09-19 and each pinned revision was confirmed against the repository's current commit.

llm.note: Integrated LLM chat models (llama.cpp GGUF) for models/llm. Every file is pinned to the commit sha of the repository and was verified with a HEAD request against its resolve URL: HTTP 200 and exactly the byte size below. The candidates are the ones llm_profiles.py recommends per hardware class, plus smaller alternatives for 4-12 GiB cards; any other llama.cpp-compatible GGUF placed in models/llm is offered as well. Qwen 3.5/3.8 GGUFs use the Gated DeltaNet architecture and need a recent llama-cpp-python build - the Llama 3.1 and Mistral entries load on older builds. None of them is downloaded by the model check - select one and it downloads on first use.

whisper.note: Lyrics transcription (faster-whisper / CTranslate2) inside models/audio_encoders. Each model is a folder of its own; the node's Whisper model dropdown is derived from these targets, and the folder that was selected is the one that gets fetched when it is missing. large-v3 is the reference; the turbo folder is roughly half the size and faster, the int8 turbo is the smallest option.
